observations: Silver pickup truck parked on a gravel lot.
Front grille features a prominent Toyota emblem.
The tailgate has 'TACOMA' embossed across the center.
A 'V6' badge is visible on the lower right of the tailgate.
The rear windshield has 'No Start 963' written in white marker.
The vehicle has black alloy wheels and black fender flares.
Side steps are installed below the doors.
The body style corresponds to the third-generation Tacoma (2016–2023).

claims.evidence: The photos show a third-generation body style (2016–2023); the 2024 model is a completely different fourth-generation design.
While the wheels and flares are consistent with TRD trims, no specific TRD badging is visible in the photos.
No 4x4 or 4WD badging is visible on the exterior shots provided.
photo 2 shows a V6 badge on the tailgate.
There are no photos of the interior to confirm the ignition type.
The roof is not visible from an angle that would confirm the presence of a moonroof.

risks.risk: The vehicle may have a major mechanical or electrical fault preventing it from running.
risks.proof: A video of the engine starting and the vehicle being driven.

risks.risk: The vehicle likely has a salvage or accident history from a US auction.
risks.proof: A photo of the VIN plate to perform a history check.

risks.risk: The actual year of manufacture is likely much older than claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturing date sticker on the driver's side door jamb.

proof_requests: Photo of the VIN plate on the dashboard or driver's door jamb.
Video of the engine starting and the vehicle driving.
Photos of the interior showing the dashboard, odometer, and start button.
Clear photo of the roof to confirm the moonroof.
Photos of the side of the bed to check for TRD or 4x4 decals.
response.reason: The seller misrepresents the vehicle as a 2024 model when the photos clearly show a previous generation (2016–2023) body style. Additionally, the 'No Start' marking on the rear window is a typical salvage auction indicator of mechanical failure, which contradicts the listing's presentation of a standard 'foreign used' vehicle.
